Working with Camilia was probably the single best decision I’ve made regarding my puppy, Sebastian. We finished her 6-week puppy course today, and I cannot believe the progress he (and I) have made in such a short time. I am truly grateful for her guidance and expertise. That’s the short version. Keep reading if you want the long one…

I have never owned a dog before. Sebastian is my first. I have a seven-year-old daughter who begged for a pet, and I really wanted to give her that experience during her childhood. I have allergies, we live in an apartment in Amsterdam, and I didn’t want a high-energy breed — so after a lot of research I landed on a Cavapoo. The internet promised they were the perfect hypoallergenic, small, calm, cuddly family dogs who love everyone. After a year of research and waiting, we came home with our tiny 8-week-old teddy bear at the end of January.

Within the first week, it became clear that everything was not alright. His vet discovered a pretty severe ear infection at his first appointment, he had digestive problems, he was eating his own poop, and he was scared of people. He wasn’t yet fully vaccinated, so I didn’t want to take him around other dogs, but he clearly needed better socialization — and I clearly needed a better source of information than YouTube. I found Ethical Dog Trainers and we started a few days later.

During our first session, Sebastian refused to come out of his carrier. I was so disappointed, but Camilia told me that was fine — he didn’t need to come out until he was ready. He wasn’t ready at all that day. So instead, Camilia and I spent over an hour talking, which was incredibly helpful and generous given that the session is officially just one hour. She gave me a lot of practical advice and directed me to her online platform, which has a ton of well-structured, easy-to-follow information.

One of the things she asked about was what I was feeding him. She explained that poor nutrition makes training significantly harder — like feeding a child candy and highly processed food all day — and referred me to a colleague nutritionist. After a lengthy intake questionnaire and a Zoom session with the nutritionist, Sebastian was put on a new meal plan. I ordered the food and waited eagerly for it to arrive.

Our second session was rough. Sebastian came out of his carrier — progress! — but barked at the other dog the entire time. I was in tears. This was not how I had imagined it would be. I felt like the situation was hopeless and I was kicking myself for getting a puppy. I felt like I had made a huge mistake, one I would have to live with for the next 10-15 years. Camilia talked me through it and helped me understand that I had very likely purchased Sebastian from a puppy mill, and he probably spent his first 8 weeks in a state of anxiety with little to no socialization. Hindsight is 20/20 — I would have been more thorough about vetting the breeder — but that ship had sailed. He was ours, and we needed to do our best with him.

That week his new food arrived, and the change was immediately noticeable. He was calmer overall, his digestion improved, his ear infection started to clear (also with the help of medicine from the vet), and he stopped eating his poop. At the next session he came out of his carrier right away, excited to be there, and was able to be around the same dog as before without barking. We were finally making progress.

Over the following 3 weeks, as he fully transitioned to his new diet, we made huge strides. Now Sebastian can sit, walk on a leash, lie down and settle on a mat, come when called, and drop things on command — which matters a lot given what he tries to pick up on our walks in the city. He can (for the most part) be around other dogs and people without freaking out. He’s like a completely different dog, and I can finally picture him as a happy, healthy, well-adjusted adult living his best life.

Needless to say, we’ll be back for the next level of classes!
Thank you so much. It was wonderful to work with you and Myla!

We took both the puppy course and the Urban Skills course with Camilia and are extremely satisfied. Camilia knows what she is talking about: she is knowledgeable, patient, and provides clear explanations during the training. Additionally, we found the lessons to be very enjoyable. Thanks to the fun format and the great variety, every week felt like a real step forward in training our pup.

We can therefore highly recommend Ethical Dog Trainers. Camilia, thank you!

Toon, Maureen, and a paw from Banjo 🐾
The puppy course with Camilia is great fun, for the pup, but also for us! Camilia has a clear and positive teaching style that we find very pleasant to apply with our pup. Definitely recommended!

Camilia is THE BEST!
She's really patient with dogs and humans too!
Knowledgeable, and caring.
We love going to the Puppy classes and can really experience how helpful they are!
Thanks from us!

When I got my first dog, Nobu, I started with a general puppy class somewhere in Amsterdam. While that provided a foundation, I soon realized I still had a lot of questions. I didn't really know my dog ​​well enough yet and felt I needed more to truly build a good bond with him and train him. That's how I found Camilia from Ethical Dog Trainers, and it was one of the best decisions I've ever made!

During the private training sessions, she really helped me understand Nobu. She teaches you not only how to train your dog, but also how to read him and better respond to his behavior. It's not just about obedience, but above all about a good partnership between you and your dog. Thanks to her guidance, Nobu now listens wonderfully, and I regularly receive compliments on how well-behaved and easy-going he is.

After the private classes, we attended additional training sessions, such as walking training and, recently, detection training. The latter was not only incredibly enjoyable for Nobu, but also for me. Camilia makes every lesson educational, practical, and fun, with a strong focus on what you and your dog need.

What I love about Camilia is her personal approach and her extensive knowledge. She truly shares your thoughts, speaks enthusiastically, and always offers practical solutions that are immediately useful.

I'm incredibly happy with everything I've learned from Camilia over the past few years and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, dedicated, and engaging dog trainer.

We did the Scent Detection Course for Beginners and it was a great success! The training group was small, what was great, because each dog got a lot of attention by the trainer. We could see progress every week and our dog Susie loved the exercise and got really into scent detection. The exercises were tailored to each dog's (and owner's!) level, so everyone could learn at their own speed. Would highly recommend it.

The dog training was fantastic! Camilia is very knowledgeable, patient, and used effective, positive reinforcement techniques. My dog showed noticeable improvement - she attended the Puppy training and the Basic training. Puppy training was essential for her (learning basic commands such as calling by her name, stay, etc) and the Basic training helped a lot with impulse-control issues. The environment was very welcoming and great for her to socialise with other dogs. After class, she always used to play and run a lot in the spacious green area where is available for the training. Highly recommend for anyone - it helps immensely to build a strong bond with your dog, they will trust you more and you will have a better communication so it will make your life easier and having a dog much more pleasant than hard work!

We started working with Camilia to train our 5 months old puppy Susan earlier this year. She is patient with our fox terrier and is very knowledgeable about different type of dogs and their personalities. It really helped us as first time puppy owners! Thank you Camilia.

My dog has learned and also enjoyed a lot. This time has brought us together. It is our first dog so this helped us a lot understanding her and her behaviors. We notice that she listens and obeys much more :D

I took my puppy course with Camilia. She is dedicated, knows what she is talking about, and took my puppy's (still) short attention span into good consideration. Don't expect to have to wait for minutes for your “turn” for a specific exercise with your dog here, as I experienced earlier in puppy training; instead, you'll find a small group where everyone can get started right away after clear explanations. If you are open to it, you will also take lessons for yourself as an owner. Great value for money and at a nice, quiet location in Amsterdam.

Camilia is an excellent dog trainer whose classes made a world of difference when I first got my puppy. The classes are concise, informative, and very fun too! I highly recommend them to anyone looking for dog training lessons.
No personal experience with them, but the fact that they explicitly mention not doing that crazy Puppy Yoga makes them worth 5 stars to me. 👌🏼 …
Freddie has the time of his life 3 days per week with Camilia. She's a great trainer and Freddie loves her. It's great to see the pictures and videos of him playing with the other dogs every week.
Camilia helped us so much with our dog. We love her approach as a positive reinforcement trainer. She is very professional and very knowledgeable. She is the best :-)
Camilia is a very kind and skilled dog trainer. The well-being of the dogs is her number one priority, and she is fully committed to it. I cannot recommend a nicer trainer in Amsterdam.

Camilia is very knowledgeable, she helps us a lot with new information, thinks along with us e.g. about possible connections between behaviours, she is also very funny. We really enjoy our time with her, and what is most important: we improved a lot together with our dog even after a few sessions
